John Cope won the 880 yards with Archie Bedford third and Len Marchant won the mile with Len Adams third. We won the senior 4 x 100 yards relay and in the field events, Charlie Jones won the long jump and John MacKenzie the discus throw.

In the 3 miles championship, the holder, Len Herbert, was a non-starter and Vern Blowfield ran an excellent race to win in the new record time of 14 mins. 49.6 secs. Reg Ruddick was second and Len Marchant third with Eddie Short fourth. The following gained standard awards: 1st class, E.
Derrick Burfitt only just lost a fast half in 1 min. 59 secs., Len Marchant won the mile in 4 mins. 29 secs., and Len Herbert the 2 miles in 9 mins. 47 secs.
Cope also turned out in the 220 and gained a point by filling fourth place. Len Marchant completed a double by winning the 880 yards in 2 min. 3 secs. and the mile in 4.31 secs.

Lowers beat Basil Walden for the first place and in the 220 yards Paddy Mullen beat Les Christmas in 23.5 secs. Len Marchant won the 880 yards in 1 min. 59.4 secs. and then turned out in the 2 miles to record another win in 9 mins. 58 secs.
